battle.name: 符離之戰
battle.brief: 隆興元年（一一六三）正月，宋樞密院事張浚率軍渡淮，魏勝鋒先至符離，圍城攻擊；金主完顏元宗遣完顏宗弼率精騎救援，一夜襲破宋營，宋軍遂潰。符離扼汴水、淮水之交。卡面那件配重投石車同齡已是西亞、歐洲的攻城主力，宋軍用的仍是砲車與雲梯，兩者正卡在同一道技術門檻上。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 此役交戰的兩方是南宋與金。隆興元年（一一六三）初，宋廷以「隆興」紀年，孝宗趙昚即位不過半年，先平反岳飛、追贈官爵，隨即任命張浚為樞密院事主持北伐。軍令分作數路：張浚自泗州渡淮，統主力直指宿州；魏勝以副都統制之銜率前鋒先渡，攻取符離；李顯忠等分屯淮西、滁州一線，與之相呼應。金方正在海陵王完顏亮死後的混亂中：完顏亮於一一六一年冬南侵至采石受阻，次年二月被部將所殺，其姪完顏元宗即位，隨即收拾海陵末政、遣使求和。金在淮東、淮西設河南統軍司與淮南統軍司，據泗州、宿州、汴水沿線的城寨與渡口，女真鐵騎與漢地州縣的糧賦並用；而汴水與淮水之間的符離，恰是金軍東路防線的支點。金廷攻城所用器械是接收自遼與北宋的舊物，宋廷倚仗的則是十年休養換來的禁軍、廂軍、弓弩與新造的火器。北伐能否成功，取決於誰先把符離插在淮水與汴水的交會點上。
countriesEn: The two parties in this battle were the Southern Song and the Jin. At the very beginning of the Longxing era in 1163 the Song court had just adopted that calendar name; Emperor Xiaozong Zhao Shen had sat on the throne for less than half a year. He had already rehabilitated Yue Fei posthumously and restored his titles, and then appointed Zhang Jun to the Office of the Privy Council to direct the northern expedition. The orders were divided into several columns: Zhang Jun himself crossed the Huai at Si prefecture with the main body, aiming straight at Su prefecture; Wei Sheng, holding the rank of deputy commander-in-chief, led the vanguard across first and stormed Fuli; Li Xianzhong and others were posted along the western Huai and at Chuzhou in support. The Jin, for their part, were in the disorder that followed the death of the Prince of Hailing, Wanyan Liang. Liang had invaded the south in the winter of 1161, had been checked at Caishi, and in the second month of the next year was killed by his own officers; his nephew Wanyan Yuanzong took the throne, at once tidying up the last years of Hailing's misrule and sending envoys to talk peace. The Jin maintained the Henan and Huainan military commissions in the eastern and western Huai, holding forts, walled towns and ferry crossings along Si prefecture, Su prefecture and the Bian waterway, using Jurchen heavy cavalry and the grain and taxes of the Han prefectures side by side. Fuli, where the Bian met the Huai, was the hinge of the Jin's eastern line. The siege engines the Jin used were inherited from the Liao and the Northern Song; what the Song counted on was the imperial and provincial troops, the bows and crossbows, and the new weapons of fire bought with a decade of peace. Whether the expedition would succeed came down to who could plant themselves first at the junction of the Huai and the Bian.
people: 此役是幾個彼此不對付的人在做同一件事。張浚，字德遠，早年從軍川陝，歷官樞密、兩淮宣撫使，隆興元年以樞密院事總領諸路軍務，是這次北伐的骨幹人物，也是事後被指為冒進而無功、遭罷黜的人。魏勝，字彥威，出身行伍，力主趁金朝內亂渡淮，領前鋒先取符離，圍城數月，是符離城下的實際指揮者；北伐失敗後他連遭貶斥，開禧三年更被韓侂胄以追議符離敗績為名賜死，直到嘉定年間才得追復官爵。淮西一路由李顯忠節制，此人以敢戰聞名，卻未及與符離合兵。和議一端由湯思退主持，他力主媾和，隆興和議成後反因擅自議和而被貶，死於江西安置之地。金方：完顏元宗以收拾海陵末政起家，一面遣使求和，一面命烏林牙郡王完顏宗弼領精騎入援，另有以驍勇著稱的唐括定哥。宋軍正是敗在這支按兵不動、隨後驟然發力的援軍手上。
peopleEn: This was a contest between several men who did not agree with one another, all bent on the same undertaking. Zhang Jun, courtesy name Deyuan, had served in the wars in Sichuan and Shaanxi from his youth, and had been privy councillor and pacification commissioner of the two Huai; as chief of the Office of the Privy Council commanding all the field armies in the first year of Longxing he was the backbone of the expedition, and the very man who afterwards was called rash and fruitless and was dismissed. Wei Sheng, courtesy name Yanwei, came up from the ranks, pressed hardest for crossing the Huai while the Jin were in confusion, led the vanguard to seize Fuli and sat down before that city for months as the actual commander on the spot; after the defeat he was demoted repeatedly, and in the third year of Kaixi he was put to death by Han Tuozhou on the pretext of reopening the case of the Fuli disaster, his office and titles being restored only in the Jiading era. The western Huai column was under Li Xianzhong, a man famous for daring to fight, though he never managed to join hands with the troops at Fuli. On the peace side the moves were made by Tang Situi, who argued for negotiation; after the Longxing settlement he was demoted for having negotiated on his own authority and died in exile in Jiangxi. On the Jin side Wanyan Yuanzong, who had risen by tidying up the wreckage of Hailing's reign, sent envoys to negotiate while also ordering the Prince of Wuling, Wanyan Zongbi, to take picked cavalry to the relief of Fuli, together with Tangkuo Dinge of the Tangkuo clan, renowned for valour. It was precisely that relieving force, which held still and then struck all at once, that beat the Song.
kits: 卡面那件配重投石車，同齡的歐亞攻城戰裡已經是常見主力。它的原理很簡單：一根長桿架在支點上，短端吊著配重，長端的兜索兜住石彈，操作手放開長端，配重砸落，把石彈向前甩出；射程遠、耗力省，十二世紀起在西亞、歐洲的圍城戰中相當普遍。符離是土築縣城，牆不算高卻厚，圍城的宋軍以砲車遠射，擊砸城牆、屋頂與守軍集結之處，逼得金軍放棄城頭、緊閉城門；同時配合雲梯附城、撞木撞門、弓弩壓制城頭。惟須留意年代差：歐亞通行的長臂配重形制在十二世紀尚未於中土普遍落地，宋廷攻城仍靠砲車、撞車、雲梯，成熟運用的配重砲要到蒙古軍帶來回回砲的十三世紀才出現。符離城下的投射器械，正正卡喺東亞舊式發石機同西式配重砲交接的那道門檻上。十二世紀的南宋並不只有冷兵器：紹興年間已有把火藥裝在陶甕裡、點火即炸的霹靂砲，也有把火藥管綁在長槍上的突火槍，另有火藥附於箭鏃的火矢；不過這些新火器仍屬奇襲之用，攻城主力依舊是砲車、撞車與弓弩。馬匹方面，宋軍渡淮靠的是楚州、泗州一線徵發的淮馬，金軍則以女真鐵騎作為突擊主力。糧秣與器械多沿汴水用漕船、牛車北運，圍城日久，全靠後方轉運接濟，一斷便是全軍的危機。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, the counterweight trebuchet, was already a common instrument of the siege warfare of its own age. The principle is simple: a long beam is pivoted at its centre, a counterweight hangs from the short end, and a sling at the long end holds the stone; when the crew release the long end, the counterweight drops and throws the stone forward out of the sling. The range is long, the manpower needed comparatively small, and from the twelfth century the machine was in common use in the sieges of West Asia and Europe. Fuli was an earth-built county town, the wall not high but thick. The Song besiegers worked it with their stone-throwers, striking at the wall, at the roofs and at the places where the garrison gathered, forcing the Jin to abandon the wall-heads and bar their gates; siege ladders went up against the wall, a ram was driven at the gate, and bows and crossbows swept the parapet. The age gap must be kept in view, however: the long counterweighted form that had become standard in Eurasia had not yet landed generally in the middle kingdom in the twelfth century, and the Song still took towns with stone-throwers, rams and ladders; the counterweight trebuchet, mature in use, only arrives in the thirteenth century with the Huihui pao that the Mongol armies brought. The artillery of the siege under Fuli thus stood exactly on the threshold where the old Chinese stone-thrower gave way to the Western counterweight machine. The Southern Song in the twelfth century was not without weapons of fire: during the Shaoxing years there was the thunder-crash bomb, a clay jar packed with gunpowder that burst when its fuse was lit, and the huo-chong qiang, a spear with a gunpowder tube bound to its head, as well as fire arrows with gunpowder attached to the arrowhead. Even so these served for surprise attacks, and the main weight of the siege still fell on stone-throwers, rams and crossbows. As for horses, the Song drew its mounts from the region around Chu and Si prefectures once it crossed the Huai, while the Jin relied on the Jurchen heavy horse for their stroke. Grain and equipment moved north by barge along the Bian waterway and by ox-cart; the longer the siege lasted, the more everything depended on the supply line behind, and if that line was cut the whole army was in danger.
tactics: 宋軍的部署是典型的分路齊進。隆興元年正月，張浚主力自泗州渡淮，宿營淮北；魏勝所部為前鋒，疾行數十日至符離，先將金軍逐出城區，築營圍困，並在營外挖壕、壘土為壁，砲車列於營門之側以壓城頭。張浚的大軍屯於符離以南，與魏勝形成前後兩層，準備合圍宿州，一舉而北。宋軍的糧道沿汴水北運，圍城越久，轉運線拉得越長，也越脆。金軍的守城戰略為死守：不出城野戰，卻以城頭弓弩、擲石及火矢反覆射擊宋軍營壘，消耗進攻方的體力與器械。金援軍抵達後不急於正面強攻，先屯於宋軍營壘之側，待夜間以重甲騎（鐵甲騎）突入宋營，藉馬的衝力破陣；宋軍營中警覺不足，一夜而潰，張浚下令退保淮南，軍隊在退卻中被金軍追擊與分割，器械、糧秣、旗鼓盡失，魏勝所部圍城之眾亦隨之瓦解。事後史家評此役，多歸咎於宋軍屯紮過於逼近敵騎來路，又未設警戒。
tacticsEn: The Song deployment was a classic multi-column advance. In the first month of the Longxing first year Zhang Jun's main body crossed the Huai at Si prefecture and encamped north of the water. Wei Sheng's vanguard, moving fast, reached Fuli after a few dozen days, drove the Jin out of the town, ringed it with earthwork, dug a ditch outside the camp and banked up the camp wall, and set its stone-throwers beside the camp gate to cover the parapet. Zhang Jun's main army was posted south of Fuli, forming two layers with Wei Sheng, ready to close on Su prefecture and drive north in one stroke. The Song supply line ran up the Bian waterway, and the longer the siege lasted the more stretched and the more fragile that line became. The Jin defence was one of staying in place: they avoided a battle in the open, but from the wall-heads they kept shooting arrows, hurling stones and loosing fire arrows into the Song camp to wear down the attackers' stamina and equipment. When the relieving force arrived it did not strike in front at once. It first took position beside the Song camp, and then in the night sent its armoured heavy horse, the iron-armoured cavalry, into the camp, using the momentum of the charge to break the line. The Song camp was insufficiently alert and came apart in a single night; Zhang Jun ordered the army back to the Huai, and during the withdrawal the Jin pursued and cut up the withdrawing columns, so that equipment, grain, drums and banners were all lost, while the siege of Fuli by Wei Sheng's men dissolved with them. Later historians have generally blamed the defeat on the Song having encamped too close to the road along which the enemy cavalry would come, and on the failure to keep a picket line.
data: 可核的數字有限，只能就其大概。時間上，隆興元年正月宋軍渡淮，符離的圍攻與破營在同年正月至二月之間；其後宋軍收兵，隆興元年秋金使議和，隆興二年十一月隆興和議成，乾道元年正式生效。距離上，符離縣城距淮水南岸的泗州約一百二三十里，距宿州州治數十里，恰在汴水漕運線上。兵力上，宋廷詔書所稱「四十萬」是連同民夫、輜重一併計算的籠統說法，實際可戰之兵多估為數萬至十餘萬，其中魏勝前鋒所部以數萬計；金方入援兵力以精騎為主，總數亦在數萬之譜，兩軍相當。損失上，宋軍為夜襲所破，退兵時被擄者以數萬計，馬匹器械糧秣盡失，符離得而復失。和議的價碼則有明文：宋稱金為伯父，歲貢銀絹各二十五萬兩匹，割唐、鄧二州；乾道元年改稱叔侄，疆界仍以淮水為界。
dataEn: Only a limited number of figures can be checked, so they can be given only roughly. In time: the Song crossed the Huai in the first month of the Longxing first year; the siege of Fuli and the breaking of the camp fell between the first and second months of the same year. The Song then drew its armies in, the Jin sent an envoy to speak of peace in the autumn of that first year, the Longxing settlement was concluded in the eleventh month of the second year, and it came into force in the first year of the Daoning era. In distance: the county town of Fuli lay about one hundred and twenty to one hundred and thirty li north of the Huai at Si prefecture and several dozen li from the seat of Su prefecture, sitting squarely on the Bian grain route. In strength: the four hundred thousand of the Song edict was a loose figure that lumped together civilians, transport workers and baggage, and the actual fighting force is generally put at several tens of thousands up to a hundred thousand and more, of which Wei Sheng's vanguard amounted to several tens of thousands. The Jin relief force was chiefly picked cavalry and likewise numbered in the tens of thousands, the two sides being roughly matched. In losses: broken by the night attack and pursued during the withdrawal, the Song left prisoners in the tens of thousands, and lost all their horses, engines and stores, while Fuli passed back to the Jin. The price of peace, by contrast, is a matter of record: the Song was to call the Jin ruler uncle, to pay annually 250,000 taels of silver and 250,000 bolts of silk, and to cede the prefectures of Tang and Deng; in the first year of Daoning the title was changed to uncle and nephew, the boundary remaining the Huai.
cause: 符離之戰不是孤立爆發的，而是十餘年休養之後第一次大規模軍事嘗試的失敗。紹興十一年（一一四一）宋金和議劃定淮水為界，兩國以叔侄相稱，宋廷藉此換得二十餘年的相安，一面在兩淮移民、興修水利、充實府庫，一面整飭禁軍、屯田募兵，把重心放在守禦。紹興三十一年，金主完顏亮撕毀和議、傾國南侵，采石一役受挫，翌年二月完顏亮被部下所殺，金廷換主，內部正在收束海陵末政，這是宋人眼中的最大空隙。紹興三十二年七月宋高宗退位，孝宗趙昚即位，詔平反岳飛、罷主和之臣，隨即於隆興元年正月任命張浚統軍北伐，意圖趁金朝混亂、將淮北收復。張浚力主乘隙渡淮，士氣亦為之一振；主和派如湯思退則從財政與糧運著眼，力陳北伐不可持久。財政吃緊、漕運線拉長與民力疲敝，本就是這場戰役背後的硬約束；一旦戰事拖成消耗戰，輸的便是宋廷。
causeEn: The battle of Fuli was not an isolated outbreak but the failure of the first large-scale military attempt in more than a decade of peace. The Song-Jin settlement of the eleventh year of Shaoxing, 1141, fixed the Huai as the boundary and had the two states call each other uncle and nephew; in exchange the Song bought more than twenty years of quiet, and used the time to settle the two Huai, to build waterworks and fill the treasuries, and at the same time to drill the imperial guards, open tuntian and recruit troops, placing the emphasis on defence. In the thirty-first year of Shaoxing the Prince of Hailing, Wanyan Liang, tore up the settlement and invaded the south with the whole realm; he was checked at Caishi, and in the second month of the next year he was killed by his own men. The Jin changed hands and the central government was busy drawing in the loose ends of Hailing's rule, and that was the widest opening the Song could see. In the seventh month of the thirty-second year of Shaoxing Emperor Gaozong abdicated and Xiaozong Zhao Shen took the throne; he rehabilitated Yue Fei, dismissed the advocates of peace, and in the first month of the Longxing first year appointed Zhang Jun to command the expedition northward, meaning to seize the moment while the Jin were unsettled and recover the country north of the Huai. Zhang Jun insisted on crossing while the gap was open, and the mood of the troops rose with him; the men of peace such as Tang Situi argued from the treasury and the grain transport that the expedition could not be sustained. Pinched finances, a stretched grain route and exhausted manpower were the hard constraints behind this battle from the start, and once the fighting turned into a war of attrition the Song was the side that lost.
impact: 符離之敗直接改變了南宋此後二十年的戰略取向。北伐草草收場，張浚罷樞密院事、貶官安置，魏勝連遭貶斥，隆興和議與乾道和議隨即把邊界重新釘回淮水，宋室從此放棄在數年內收復淮北的打算，轉而固守兩岸：以臨安為中心的城防體系加密，兩淮的城寨、堡壘與屯田大幅擴充，弓弩、神臂弓與各式砲車成為守城主力，軍費結構長期偏向守禦與歲貢。這種取向延續到開禧北伐時仍未改變。對器械史而言，此役的意義在另一面：宋軍攻符離所倚的仍是砲車、撞車、雲梯這類成熟工程器械，火器只在火矢、突火槍、陶甕火藥砲的階段；同一個十二世紀，配重式投石機在西亞與歐洲已是攻城主力之一，而中土方面的配重砲要到蒙古軍帶來回回砲的十三世紀才真正落地。符離城下的攻防，正是中亞式攻城術與東亞傳統攻城術在十二世紀的分野所在。魏勝的冤案也拖了數十年：開禧三年他被韓侂胄以追論符離敗績為名賜死，嘉定初年朝廷平反追贈，這宗公案成為南宋追責軍事的著名案例。
impactEn: The defeat at Fuli changed the strategic orientation of the Southern Song for the twenty years that followed. The expedition was wound up hastily, Zhang Jun was stripped of the privy council and sent into exile, Wei Sheng was demoted again and again, and the Longxing and Daoning settlements nailed the border back to the Huai. From then on the Song gave up the idea of recovering the north bank within a few years and turned to holding the two shores: the defensive system centred on Lin'an was reinforced, forts, stockades and tuntian across the two Huai were greatly expanded, bows, the powerful Shenli crossbow and every kind of stone-thrower became the backbone of the garrison, and military spending was permanently skewed towards defence and the annual tribute. That orientation was still unchanged when the Kaixi expedition was launched. As for the history of weapons, the interest of this battle lies elsewhere: the Song army that stormed Fuli still leaned on mature engineering, the stone-thrower, the ram and the siege ladder, while weapons of fire remained at the stage of the fire arrow, the huo-chong qiang and the clay bomb. In the same twelfth century the counterweight trebuchet was already one of the main siege engines of West Asia and Europe, while in the middle kingdom the counterweight trebuchet would not really take root until the Mongol armies brought the Huihui pao in the thirteenth century. The siege under Fuli is exactly where the Central Asian style of siegecraft and the East Asian tradition of siegecraft parted company in the twelfth century. Wei Sheng's case also dragged on for decades: in the third year of Kaixi he was put to death by Han Tuozhou on the ground of reviewing the Fuli defeat, and the court redressed it and restored his titles only at the beginning of the Jiading era; that long afterlife made the case a famous example of how the Song court held its own commanders to account.
result: 結果是金軍得勝。符離城在金援軍夜襲宋營、主力潰散之後得而復失，宋軍退回淮南，隆興北伐各路兵馬相繼收隊，北伐宣告失敗。追究戰敗責任，張浚被罷樞密院事、貶官安置，魏勝貶官外放，兩淮戰線重歸僵持。隆興元年秋，金遣使議和；隆興二年十一月，和議成，宋稱金為伯父，歲貢銀絹各二十五萬兩匹，割唐、鄧二州；乾道元年再議，兩國改稱叔侄，疆界仍以淮水為界，宋軍北伐的成果全部歸零。符離之戰作為南宋第一次北伐的終點，標誌著紹興以來守和路線重新抬頭，也讓張浚、魏勝這些主張北進的名字付出了長年被貶的代價；魏勝的平反直到嘉定年間才落實，意味著這場敗仗在宋廷內部的評價，多年之後仍未定論。戰役留下的實物教訓也被寫進了後來的守城章程：營壘必須離敵騎來路留出緩衝，宿營必須設警戒與烽火，糧道必須有替代線；符離的教訓，後來在兩淮諸城的城防圖與守城條例裡仍能看見影子。
resultEn: The Jin won. Fuli changed hands back to them once the relieving army had broken the Song camp in the night and the main body came apart; the Song fell back to the south of the Huai, the columns of the northern expedition were drawn in one after another, and the expedition was over. For the responsibility of the defeat, Zhang Jun was removed from the privy council and demoted into exile, Wei Sheng was stripped of his rank and sent away, and the line on the two Huai sank back into stalemate. In the autumn of the first year the Jin sent an envoy to talk peace; in the eleventh month of the second year the settlement was concluded, the Song to call the Jin ruler uncle, paying 250,000 taels of silver and 250,000 bolts of silk each year and ceding the prefectures of Tang and Deng. In the first year of the Daoning era the two states renegotiated and became uncle and nephew, the boundary remaining the Huai, so that everything the expedition had won was reduced to nothing. As the end of the Song's first northern expedition, the battle of Fuli marked the reassertion of the line of peace followed since Shaoxing, and it cost Zhang Jun, Wei Sheng and the other advocates of advance years of demotion and exile. Wei Sheng was not cleared until the Jiading era, which means that for many years after it, the Song court's own assessment of this defeat had not been finally settled. The practical lessons of the battle were written into the later manuals on holding walled towns: encampments were to be set back from the road along which enemy cavalry would come, camp were to keep a watch and beacon line, and the grain route was to have an alternative. In the maps of the fortified towns of the two Huai and in the regulations for their defence, the shadow of Fuli can still be seen.
